t:
Which of the following statement is correct with reference to ALOP policies?

I. It is issued in advance of the actual commencement of business
II. It is always issued as an extension of EAR / CAR insurance policy under a separate section
III. This policy also covers financial consequences of a delay in estimated commercial operation date of a project
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ABC Ltd is manufacturing company. They use diesel generator sets in their factory. Which factor needs to be taken care the most to safe guard their diesel generator sets?
o: Contamination of oil due to moisture and contamina
e: Correct answer: Overheating and insulation failures (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are examples of construction phase policies?

I. Contractor's All Risks (CAR) insurance
II. Contract Works (CW) insurance
III. Deterioration of Stocks insurance
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Mr. A is the finance manager of an infrastructure company. His company is starting a new project. He has suggested the management that the ways and means of financing of the project shall be decided during the detailed project planning stage. Is Mr. A right? Choose the most appropriate option.
o: The finance decisions are taken during feasibility study satge
The finance decisions are taken after land acquisi
e: Correct answer: The finance decisions are taken during feasibility study satge (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the general exclusions in a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy?

I. Loss or damage due to human error
II. Loss due to cessation of malicious damage
III. Loss or damage due to wilful negligence
e: Correct answer: II&III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Five sets of endorsement wordings are available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.). Which set pertains to design improvement exclusion?
e: Correct answer: DE 5 (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are covered under the Industrial All Risks Insurance (IAR) policy?

I. Machinery Break down insurance
II. Machinery Loss of profits insurance
III. Fire insurance
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The management of Turbo Ltd., a construction company wants to know which of the following are the determining factors for delayed start up insurance in a CPI Policy?

I. The sum insured
II. The maximum indemnity period
III. The type of construction or erection project
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following is a valid underwriting consideration under a boiler and pressure plant insurance policy?

I. Type of boiler
II. Age of boiler
III. Whether the company is listed on stock exchange
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Certain systematic replacements and preventive operations can be avoided or delayed if there is a means of diagnosis for assessing the condition of a part and its degree of wear and tear. This can be done through:

I. Preventive maintenance
II. Corrective maintenance
III. Predictive maintenance
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Arrange these stages of a project in their correct order.

I. Feasibility Study
II. Detailed project planning
III. Call for tender
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
As per the Institute Cargo Clauses a marine policy would expire when:

I. Equipment are delivered to an intermediate warehouse
II. Equipment are sent to a workshop for additional work
III. Equipment arrive at the port of destination
e: Correct answer: I or II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which set of endorsement wordings available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.) correspond to standard CAR policy?
e: Correct answer: DE 1 (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Third party risks are not covered under the Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: Third party risks to person and property are covered as supplementary covers subject to adjustment of premium
Only third party property risks are covered under
e: Correct answer: Third party risks to person and property are covered as supplementary covers subject to adjustment of premium (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following risks is a pressure plant exposed to?

I. Distortion or breakage of the crankshaft
II. Explosion due to internal pressure and collapse
III. Mechanical and electrical breakdown
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The insurance policy taken for boiler and pressure plants is titled in India as __________.
o: Boiler and Pressure Vessel Insurance Policy
Boiler and Pressure Plant Insurance Policy
Boiler and Pressure Vessel explosion Insurance Pol
e: Correct answer: Boiler and Pressure Plant Insurance Policy (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following come in the ambit of engineering insurance?

I. Nuclear energy installations
II. Satellites
III. Mines
e: Correct answer: ONLY I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following do not come under the definition of factory under the Indian Factories Act 1948?

I. Industrial unit manufacturing LED lights
II. Industrial unit manufacturing wine
III. A mine to extract coal
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: _______ shall mean any unfired closed container under steam, gas, or fluid pressure.
e: Correct answer: Pressure plant (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
BKC limited is an engineering company. It has taken an Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy for its factory. It has incurred the following losses at its factory. Which of the following losses are general exclusions in a EAR insurance policy?

I. Damages due to short circuit in factory
II. Damage of boxes meant for packing
III. Damages due to defective cement
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In respect of electronic equipment, the sum insured in an electronic equipment insurance policy should represent which of the following values?

I. Depreciated value of the items covered
II. Resale value of the items covered
III. New replacement value of the items covered
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the general exclusions in a Contractors All Risk (CAR) insurance policy?

I. Loss or damage due to human error
II. Loss due to cessation of malicious damage
III. Loss or damage due to willful negligence
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Under a boiler and pressure plant insurance policy which of following statement is / are correct?

I. It covers the risk of 'explosion' and 'collapse'
II. This policy covers the damage to other surrounding property of the Insured caused by fire EXPLOSION
III. Explosion arising in the course of ordinary working only is covered
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is/are true for endorsements?

I. Endorsements and original contract together constitute evidence of insurance contract.
II. Endorsements are not standardised and can be issued in any form
III. Endorsements can be issued at the time of original policy or during the currency of policy
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are true with regards to operating in a new venture?

I. Inexperienced staff
II. Established infrastructure
III. Product demand is uncertain
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Five sets of Endorsement wordings are available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.) Wordings. Which set pertains to extended defective condition exclusion?
e: Correct answer: DE 2 (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In order to cover both erection and construction risks and to provide comprehensive protection, Munich Re developed ____________.
e: Correct answer: Comprehensive Project Insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Mechanical and electrical parts of any steam turbine in shall be inspected and overhauled on completion of minimum 32,000 hours of operation or _________ years whichever is earlier.
e: Correct answer: 4 years (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
ABC Corp. has applied for a MLOP insurance. The company wants to know as to when does the indemnity period commence in case the policy is exercised? Advise.

I. End of one year from issue of policy
II. Commencement of commercial operations
III. From the date of accident
o: I or II whichever is earlier
II or III whichever is earlier
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
As per the CPM insurance, in cases where the damage can be indemnified, the cost of restoration shall include which of the following costs?

I. Normal freight
II. Erection cost
III. Duties and taxes
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is not included in sub-stations?

I. Transformers
II. Boilers
III. Circuit breakers
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The cover provided in an Erection All Risk (EAR) policy is on an 'All Risks' basis i.e. every hazard is covered without any exclusions. State your opinion. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: This statement is wrong as there a few exclusions to the EAR policy which are generally mentioned in the policy document
This statement is partially right as EAR insurance
e: Correct answer: This statement is wrong as there a few exclusions to the EAR policy which are generally mentioned in the policy document (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Mechanical and electrical parts of any steam turbine in shall be inspected and overhauled on completion of minimum:-

I. 32,000 hours of operation or four years whichever is earlier.
II. 20,000 hours of operation or four years whichever is earlier.
III. 32,000 hours of operation or two years whichever is earlier.
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
What is the purpose of including time excess in the ALOP policy?

I. To absorb the effects of delay due to minor events which are inherent to the project
II. To reduce the risk of the underwriter
III. To prevent loss to the owners
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Section 18 of the Indian Boilers Act stipulates compulsory reporting of accident to appropriate authority (Inspector) within __________ of accident.
e: Correct answer: 24 hours (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Obligatory contract' is the name that one can give to the category of:-
e: Correct answer: Treaty reinsurance contracts (from the IC77 question bank).

t: An insured item is regarded as totally destroyed if _______________.
o: The market value equals or exceeds its value immed
The repair cost equals or exceeds its value immediately before the accident
The depreciated value equals or exceeds its value
The repair cost equals or is lower in comparison t
The depreciated value equals or is lower in compar
e: Correct answer: The repair cost equals or exceeds its value immediately before the accident (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In a boiler and pressure plant policy, which of the sum insured under the insurance policy is subject to pro-rata average?

I. Each item of plant insured
II. Insured's own surrounding property damage
III. Third Party Liability
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the plant and machinery can be insured under the machinery insurance policy?

I. Engines
II. Turbines
III. Blowers
o: Neither of I, II or III
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Any loss or damage occurring due to act of defective workmanship and material shall be indemnified in a Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy. Debate.
o: The loss or damage caused due to human error and d
The loss or damage caused due to lack of skill, de
e: Correct answer: This statement is wrong (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Alfatech Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Comprehensive Project Insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses shall be covered as per the CPI policy?

I. Damages due to accident of truck used to transport materials
II. Penalty imposed by contract labour inspector
III. Damage of chains and ropes on site
o: None of I, II and III
e: Correct answer: None of I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following objects are suitable for a cover under the comprehensive machinery insurance?

I. Refineries
II. Equipment at open-cast mines
III. Plants in the metalworking industry
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance covers damages caused due to which of the following perils?

I. Tornado
II. Theft & Burglary
III. Defective materials
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Management of a construction company has started a new project. They wanted to know that the discussions related to selection of designs and materials, approximate project cost, cost benefit analysis, economics of the project, etc. shall be carried out during which phase of project planning. Advise them.
e: Correct answer: Feasibility study (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The material damage sum insured must be equal to the estimated completely erected value of the contract works inclusive of which of the following?

I. Materials and wages
II. Supervision costs, freight and customs duties
III. Items supplied by the Principal
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
How are the claims under the third party section dealt with in a standard boiler and pressure plant insurance policy?

I. Settled up to the amount of the loss not exceeding the Sum Insured without deduction for average
II. Settled up to the amount of the loss not exceeding the Sum Insured after deduction for average
III. Settled up to the amount of the loss and may exceed the sum insured without deduction for average IV. Settled up to the amount of the loss and may exceed the sum insured after deduction for average
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The term 'Contracts works' used in British and European context mean the same
II. CAR policy is more suited for contracts predominantly involving civil engineering works
III. EAR policy would cater to plant / machinery erection contracts
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

fuel is introduced in the combustion chamber of the gas turbine unit
